title: Is ChatGPT Massively Used by Students Nowadays? A Survey on the Use of Large Language Models such as ChatGPT in Educational Settings

bias_targets.methodology: Statistical analysis (including chi-squared tests and confidence intervals) of survey responses from 395 students to compare ChatGPT usage frequency, user satisfaction, and response revision habits across four distinct age groups ranging from 13 to 25+ years old.

Statistical analysis of survey responses to evaluate demographic disparities in LLM adoption, measuring differences in usage frequency, academic topic preferences (e.g., sciences vs. humanities), and ethical concerns between male and female students.
